disposition: quarter- to half-acre fire in heavy brush and grass, burning slowly; crews worked access from the river side
summary: A fire burning in heavy brush and grass in a riparian area was reported at roughly a quarter- to half-acre in size and moving slowly. Crews worked out how to reach it, weighing access from the river side, and additional resources were requested while the fire stayed within heavy fuels.

disposition: call held for a victim of a recent robbery
summary: A caller reported being the victim of a recent armed robbery and gave a description of a suspect in a green shirt, gray pants, green hat and white shoes.

disposition: officers sent to the parking lot
summary: Officers were sent to a convenience store parking lot for a man with an open alcohol container who was refusing to leave and harassing customers.

disposition: call pending; suspect and vehicle described
summary: A theft reported earlier in the evening at a Ming Avenue home improvement store was passed to patrol units with a suspect vehicle description and the incident left pending for service.

disposition: deputies responding; parties separated over a phone
summary: Deputies were sent to a disturbance between a caller and her husband that deputies described as an argument over a cell phone at a Stine Road address.

disposition: routine backup requested
summary: Deputies asked for a routine backup at a lake recreation area where about 60 other vehicles had gathered in the area.

area: Panama Lane at Mountain Vista Drive, Bakersfield
disposition: call logged for a check
summary: A caller near a Panama Lane intersection reported a bright light coming from an electrical box and believed someone was inside it.

disposition: call screened; juvenile at the residence
summary: Officers took a report in which a juvenile living at a Quincy Street apartment said her mother battered her and put a knee on her neck. She was reported to be at the residence while the call was screened.

disposition: deputies responding; firearm access reported
summary: Deputies were sent to a mobile home park for a domestic disturbance between a woman and her partner. The caller reported the man had access to a firearm and was refusing to let her leave.

disposition: pursuit ended at a residence parking lot
summary: A pursuit ran westbound along California Avenue with speeds reported from about 60 up to 95 mph, with officers calling out light traffic and no pedestrians. The vehicle turned north off the avenue and into a residence parking lot, where units moved in.

disposition: deputy assigned
summary: A deputy was assigned to check on a resident on the Main Street block in Maricopa, where the caller reported trash in front of the property and multiple dogs in the yard.

disposition: officers en route
summary: Officers were sent to investigate a report of shots heard and a related call was tied to a prior weapons report from last month.

area: northbound Interstate 5 south of Grapevine, Kern County
disposition: driver declined a tow; hazards on
summary: A car with a flat tire and no spare was reported in the center divide on northbound Interstate 5 south of Grapevine, with hazard lights on. The driver had tried to arrange service through insurance and declined a CHP tow.

area: Niles Street block near Mount Vernon Avenue, east Bakersfield
disposition: officers sent
summary: Officers were sent to a Niles Street business across from Mount Vernon Avenue for a man in dark clothing reported to be under the influence and refusing to leave.

disposition: backyard, attic and neighborhood searched; officers fanned out on foot
summary: After a pursuit ended at a home, officers searched the backyard and an attic and then fanned out on foot through surrounding streets for the people involved. One subject was reported to be in the backyard, and a second was last seen walking west. A K-9 and additional units joined the search and officers checked several spots where someone could hide.

disposition: line disconnected, no callback; officers checking
summary: An open line came in with a woman asking someone to get off of her. The line disconnected and a callback went unanswered, and officers were sent to check the area.

disposition: lanes blocked; heavy-duty tow requested
summary: A tractor-trailer was reported disabled in the number four lane of southbound Interstate 5 with the driver out putting out triangles, and a second semi was on the right-hand shoulder. Units reported the crash and requested a heavy-duty tow.

area: Niles Street at Ashe Road, Bakersfield
disposition: officers checking the area
summary: Officers were sent to Niles Street at Ashe Road for two subjects dressed in all black, one in a blue shirt and black pants.

disposition: investigation
summary: Officers took a call involving two 18-year-olds, a male and a female, both described in dark clothing.

area: railroad tracks north of Highway 58, Bakersfield
disposition: large wildland assignment; air-to-ground coordination requested
summary: A vegetation fire reported near the Union Pacific Railroad tracks north of Highway 58 drew a heavy assignment just after 5 a.m. Two engines, three patrol units, a water tender, two dozers and multiple battalion chiefs were sent, a helicopter was placed on standby, and air-to-ground coordination was requested if needed.
